```{r helper functions}
#> Investigating the accuracy of inference by using MJM
predict_long <- function(jm, cytokine_idx, day = 0, data.long, keep_iter = 1000) {
  subjects <- as.character(jm$model_data$idT)
  X_pred <- data.frame(Subject_id = subjects,
                       arm = sapply(subjects, function(s) unique( data.long$arm[data.long$Subject_id == s])[1]),
                       day = day)
  
  Zmat <- model.matrix(~ day, X_pred)
  Xmat <- model.matrix(~ day * arm, X_pred)
  K <- 2
  idx_start <- (cytokine_idx - 1) * K + 1
  idx_end   <- cytokine_idx * K
  RE_idx <- idx_start:idx_end
  n_chains <- length(jm$mcmc$b)
  pred_list <- vector("list", keep_iter * n_chains)
  counter <- 1
  
  for(chain in seq_len(n_chains)) {

    for(iter in seq_len(keep_iter)) {

      # random effects
      b_all <- jm$mcmc$b[[chain]][ , RE_idx, iter]
      # preserve matrix structure
      b_all <- matrix(
        b_all,
        ncol = K
      )
      rand_part <- rowSums(
        Zmat * b_all
      )
      # fixed effects
      beta <- jm$mcmc[[paste0("betas", cytokine_idx)]][[chain]][iter, ]
      fix_part <- as.vector(Xmat %*% beta)
      pred <- fix_part + rand_part
      names(pred) <- subjects
      pred_list[[counter]] <- pred
      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  }

  return(pred_list)
}
#> Inference longitudinal trajectory
predict_jm_trajectory <- function(
    jm,
    metabolite_idx,
    data.long,
    time_vec = c(0, 30),
    keep_iter = NULL,
    name_map = NULL
) {

  library(dplyr)

  subjects <- as.character(jm$model_data$idT)
  n_chains <- length(jm$mcmc$b)
  if (is.null(keep_iter)) {
    keep_iter <- nrow(jm$mcmc$betas1[[1]])
  }
  iter_use <- seq_len(keep_iter)
  metname.model <- names(jm$model_data$extra_parms)
  if (!is.null(name_map)) {
    met_names <- unname(
      name_map1[metname.model]
    )
  } else {
    met_names <- metname.model
  }
  met_name <- met_names[metabolite_idx]
  X_pred <- expand.grid(
    Subject_id = subjects,
    day = time_vec
  )
  X_pred$arm <- sapply(
    X_pred$Subject_id,
    function(s) {
      unique(
        data.long$arm[
          data.long$Subject_id == s
        ]
      )[1]
    }
  )
  X_pred$arm <- factor(X_pred$arm)
  Zmat <- model.matrix( ~ day, X_pred)
  Xmat <- model.matrix(
    ~ day * arm,
    X_pred
  )
  
  K <- 2
  RE_idx <- ((metabolite_idx - 1) * K + 1):(metabolite_idx * K)

  pred_draws <- simplify2array(
    lapply(iter_use, function(iter) {
      do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(chain) {
          b_it <- jm$mcmc$b[[chain]][ , RE_idx, iter, drop = FALSE]
          b_it <- matrix(b_it, ncol = K)
          rand_part <- rowSums( Zmat * b_it[match(X_pred$Subject_id,
                  subjects),
                ,drop = FALSE])
          beta_it <- jm$mcmc[[paste0("betas", metabolite_idx)]][[chain]][iter, ]
          fix_part <- as.vector(Xmat %*% beta_it)
          fix_part + rand_part
        })
      )
    })
  )
  # Convert: prediction × chain × iteration -> prediction × posterior_draw
  pred_mat <- matrix(
    aperm(pred_draws, c(1, 3, 2)),
    nrow = nrow(X_pred)
  )
  traj_df <- data.frame(
    Subject_id = X_pred$Subject_id,
    day = X_pred$day,
    arm = X_pred$arm,
    median = apply(pred_mat,1,median),
    lwr = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile,0.025),
    upr = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile, 0.975)
  )
  obs_df <- data.long %>% dplyr::select(Subject_id, day, arm, all_of(met_name))
  final_df <- traj_df %>% left_join(
      obs_df,by = c("Subject_id","day","arm" )) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(pred = median, obs = all_of(met_name)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(value = if_else(!is.na(obs),obs,pred),
                  source = if_else(!is.na(obs),"observed","JM_imputed"), 
                  metabolite = met_name)
  # population-level trajectory
  pop_grid <- expand.grid(
    day = sort(unique(time_vec)),
    arm = levels(X_pred$arm)
  )
  X_pop <- model.matrix(~ day * arm,pop_grid)

  pop_draws <- simplify2array(
    lapply(iter_use, function(iter) {
      do.call(
        cbind,
        lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(chain) {
          beta_it <- jm$mcmc[[paste0("betas", metabolite_idx)]][[chain]][iter, ]
          as.vector(X_pop %*% beta_it)
        })
      )
    })
  )
  pop_mat <- matrix(
    aperm(pop_draws, c(1, 3, 2)),
    nrow = nrow(X_pop)
  )
  pop_df <- data.frame(
    day = pop_grid$day,
    arm = pop_grid$arm,
    median = apply(pop_mat,1,median),
    lwr = apply(pop_mat,1,quantile,0.025),
    upr = apply(pop_mat,1,quantile,0.975),
    metabolite = met_name
  )
  return(
    list(
      traj_df = traj_df,
      final_df = final_df,
      pop_df = pop_df,
      pred_mat = pred_mat,
      pop_mat = pop_mat
    )
  )
}
#> Wald p-value
wald_from_samples <- function(x) {
  est <- mean(x)
  se <- sd(x)
  z <- est / se
  p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))
  data.frame(
    estimate = est,
    se = se,
    z = z,
    p = p
  )
}
#> Summarise posterior distribution
summarise_posterior <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  data.frame(
    median = median(x),
    mean   = mean(x),
    sd     = sd(x),
    lwr    = quantile(x, 0.025),
    upr    = quantile(x, 0.975)
  )
}
#> Beta table report
build_beta_table_mv <- function(jm,
                                met_names) {
  res_list <- lapply(seq_along(met_names),
                     function(i) {
                       met <- met_names[i]
                       beta_mat <- beta_matrix(jm, i)
                       post <- pop_slope_mv(jm = jm, metabolite_idx = i)
                       placebo_sum <- summarise_posterior(post$placebo)
                       dex_sum <- summarise_posterior(post$dexamethasone)
                       delta_sum <- summarise_posterior(post$delta)
                       
                       beta_placebo <- beta_mat[, "day"]
                       wald_placebo <- wald_from_samples(beta_placebo)
                       beta_delta <- beta_mat[, "day:armDexamethasone"]
                       wald_delta <- wald_from_samples(beta_delta)
                       beta_dex <- beta_mat[, "day"] + beta_mat[, "day:armDexamethasone"]
                       wald_dex <- wald_from_samples(beta_dex)
                       
                       delta_df <- data.frame(
                         metabolite = met,
                         contrast   = "Delta",
                         median     = delta_sum$median,
                         mean       = delta_sum$mean,
                         sd         = delta_sum$sd,
                         lwr        = delta_sum$lwr,
                         upr        = delta_sum$upr,
                         p          = wald_delta$p
                       )
                       placebo_df <- data.frame(
                         metabolite = met,
                         contrast   = "Placebo",
                         median     = placebo_sum$median,
                         mean       = placebo_sum$mean,
                         sd         = placebo_sum$sd,
                         lwr        = placebo_sum$lwr,
                         upr        = placebo_sum$upr,
                         p          = wald_placebo$p
                       )
                       dex_df <- data.frame(
                         metabolite = met,
                         contrast   = "Dexamethasone",
                         median     = dex_sum$median,
                         mean       = dex_sum$mean,
                         sd         = dex_sum$sd,
                         lwr        = dex_sum$lwr,
                         upr        = dex_sum$upr,
                         p          = wald_dex$p
                       )
                       rbind(placebo_df,
                             dex_df,
                             delta_df)
                     })
  beta_table <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
  rownames(beta_table) <- NULL
  return(beta_table)
}
get_beta_mat <- function(jm_fit, metabolite, lme_names) {
  idx <- match(metabolite, lme_names)
  if (is.na(idx)) stop("Metabolite not found")
  beta_obj <- jm_fit$mcmc[[paste0("betas", idx)]]
  ## Extract each chain and stack
  beta_mat <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(beta_obj, function(x) as.matrix(x))
  )
  beta_mat
}
extract_slope_posteriors_mv <- function(jm_fit, metabolite, lme_names) {
  beta_mat <- get_beta_mat(jm_fit, metabolite, lme_names)
  if (is.list(beta_mat)) {
    beta_mat <- beta_mat[[metabolite]] %||% beta_mat[[1]]
  }
  beta_mat <- as.matrix(beta_mat)
  beta_day <- beta_mat[, "day"]
  beta_int <- beta_mat[, "day:armDexamethasone"]
  list(
    beta_placebo = beta_day,
    beta_dex     = beta_day + beta_int,
    delta_beta   = beta_int
  )
}
#> Wald p-value for report
Wald_P_cal_mv <- function(jm_fit, metabolite, lme_names,
                          coef_name = "day:armDexamethasone") {

  beta_mat <- get_beta_mat(jm_fit, metabolite, lme_names)

  beta_vec <- beta_mat[, coef_name]

  beta_vec <- as.numeric(beta_vec)

  est <- mean(beta_vec)
  se  <- sd(beta_vec)

  z <- est / se
  p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))

  return(p)
}
#> Visualisation helper function
plot_met_trajectory <- function(met_name,
                                all_final_df,
                                all_pop_df,
                                name_map = NULL) {
  display_name <- if (!is.null(name_map)) {
    unname(name_map[met_name])
  } else {
    met_name
  }
  stat_row <- delta_labels %>%
    dplyr::filter(metabolite == met_name)
  beta_text <- paste0(
    "\u2206\u03B2 = ",
    sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$beta),
    " [",
    sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$lwr),
    ", ",
    sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$upr),
    "]",
    "; Wald-FDR = ",
    sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$fdr)
  )
  plot_dat <- all_final_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(metabolite == met_name)
  pop_dat <- all_pop_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(metabolite == met_name)
  
  # y_top <- max(plot_dat$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # x_left <- min(plot_dat$day, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # subject-specific trajectories
    geom_line(
      data = plot_dat,
      aes(
        x = day,
        y = value,
        group = interaction(Subject_id, arm),
        colour = arm
      ),
      alpha = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    # population CrI
    geom_ribbon(
      data = pop_dat,
      aes(
        x = day,
        ymin = lwr,
        ymax = upr,
        fill = arm
      ),
      alpha = 0.25,
      colour = NA
    ) +
    # population mean trajectory
    geom_line(data = pop_dat,
              aes(x = day,
                  y = median,
                  colour = arm),
              linewidth = 1.4) +
    annotate("text",x = 1, y = 4.8, label = beta_text,hjust = 0,vjust = 1,size = 4,color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 30)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 5)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "Placebo" = "#1f77b4",
      "Dexamethasone" = "#d62728"
    )) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Placebo" = "#1f77b4",
      "Dexamethasone" = "#d62728"
    )) +
    labs(
      x = "Study day",
      y = display_name,
      colour = "Treatment",
      fill = "Treatment"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 15,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 10,
        r = 10,
        b = 30,
        l = 10
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15,
                                  face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15,
                                  face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold",
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold",
        color = "black"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14,
                                face = "bold"),
      legend.position = c(0.75, 0.18),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7),
                                       colour = "white"),
      legend.key = element_blank()
    )
  return(p)
}
```

```{r inference_accuracy_hivnegative}
# results_multi_hivneg
data.long <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$long_LTA4Hrm
data.long$Subject_id <- factor(data.long$Subject_id)

jm <- results_multi_hivneg
metname.model <- names(results_multi_hivneg$model_data$extra_parms)

metname.orig <- unname(name_map1[metname.model])
plot_df_list <- vector("list",length(metname.model))
rmse_tbl <- data.frame()
#> prediction matrix
for(metabolite_idx in seq_along(metname.model)) {
    pred_list <- predict_long(
        jm = results_multi_hivneg,
        cytokine_idx = metabolite_idx,
        day = 30,
        data.long = data.long)
    pred_mat <- do.call(cbind, pred_list)
    pred_median <- apply(pred_mat,1,median)
    obs_baseline <- data.long %>%
        filter(day == 30) %>%
        dplyr::select(Subject_id,obs = all_of(metname.orig[metabolite_idx]))
    obs_baseline$pred <- pred_median[
        match(obs_baseline$Subject_id,
            names(pred_median))]
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((obs_baseline$obs - obs_baseline$pred)^2,na.rm = TRUE))
    obs_baseline$metabolite <- metname.orig[
        metabolite_idx]
    obs_baseline$RMSE <- rmse
    plot_df_list[[metabolite_idx]] <- obs_baseline
    
    rmse_tbl <- rbind(
        rmse_tbl,
        data.frame(metabolite = metname.orig[metabolite_idx],RMSE = rmse))
}
plot_df <- bind_rows(plot_df_list)
plot_df$metabolite <- name_map2[plot_df$metabolite]
rmse_tbl$metabolite <- name_map2[rmse_tbl$metabolite]
facet_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(rmse_tbl$metabolite,
        "\nRMSE = ",
        round(rmse_tbl$RMSE, 2)),
    rmse_tbl$metabolite)
plot_df$metabolite <- factor(
  plot_df$metabolite,
  levels = met_order
)
p_all <- ggplot(plot_df,aes(x = obs, y = pred)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_smooth(
        method = "lm",
        color = "darkred",
        fill = "#d62728",
        se = TRUE) + 
  facet_wrap(
        ~ metabolite,
        nrow = 2, ncol = 5,
        scales = "free",
        labeller = labeller(
            metabolite = facet_labels)) +
  labs(subtitle = NULL,
        x = "Observed value",
        y = "Predicted value")+ theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.background=element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = 'white'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="plain", colour="black", size=12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="plain", colour="black", size=12),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(face="plain",size = 12),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text=element_text(face = "bold", size=12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_all
ggsave(
  filename = "./plots/JM_inference_accuracy_HIVnegative_D30.tiff",
  plot = p_all,
  device = "tiff",
  width = 17,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```

```{r MJM_Inference_Table}
beta_table_mv_hivnegative <- build_beta_table_mv(
  jm = results_multi_hivneg,

  beta_table_mv$p,

met_names <- names(results_multi_hivpos$model_data$extra_parms)
beta_table_mv_hivpositive <- build_beta_table_mv(
  jm = results_multi_hivpos,
  met_names = met_names)
beta_table_mv_hivpositive$fdr <- p.adjust(
  beta_table_mv$p,
  method = "BH")
beta_table_mv_hivpositive$metabolite <- name_map_tbl[beta_table_mv_hivpositive$metabolite]

beta_table_mv_hivnegative$cohort <- "HIV-negative"
beta_table_mv_hivpositive$cohort <- "HIV-positive"

beta_table_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  beta_table_mv_hivnegative,
  beta_table_mv_hivpositive
)

beta_table_all$contrast <- factor(
  beta_table_all$contrast,
  levels = c(
    "Placebo",
    "Dexamethasone",
    "Delta"
  )
)
beta_table_all$metabolite <- factor(
  beta_table_all$metabolite,
  levels = met_order
)
beta_all_fmt <- beta_table_all %>%
  mutate(
    est_cri = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      median,
      lwr,
      upr
    ),
    
    p = ifelse(
      is.na(p),
      "",
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)
    ),
    
    fdr = ifelse(
      is.na(fdr),
      "",
      formatC(fdr, format = "e", digits = 2)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    cohort,
    metabolite,
    contrast
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    cohort,
    metabolite,
    contrast,
    est_cri,
    p,
    fdr
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Cohort = cohort,
    Metabolite = metabolite,
    Contrast = contrast,
    `β [95% CrI]` = est_cri,
    `Wald-p` = p,
    `BH-FDR` = fdr
  )

ft <- flextable(beta_all_fmt)
ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
ft <- autofit(ft)
ft <- merge_v(ft,j = c("Cohort", "Metabolite"))
ft <- valign(ft,valign = "top",part = "body")
ft <- bold(ft,part = "header")
ft <- align(ft,align = "center",part = "all")
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_add_par(doc,
  "Population-level longitudinal slopes from multivariate joint models",
  style = "heading 1")
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc,value = ft)
print(doc,target = "./tables/MJM_trajectory_2cohorts.docx")
```

```{r multivariate_MJM}
#> HIV-positive TBM
beta_table_mv <- lapply(names(lme_list), function(met) {
  betas <- extract_slope_posteriors_mv(
    results_multi_hivpos,
    met,
    names(lme_list)
  )
  data.frame(
    metabolite = met,
    rbind(
      Placebo       = summarise_beta(betas$beta_placebo),
      Dexamethasone = summarise_beta(betas$beta_dex),
      Delta         = summarise_beta(betas$delta_beta)
    )
  )
})
```

We visualize the longitudinal changes of tryptophan metabolites in HIV-negative TBM cohort
```{r}
all_res <- lapply(
  seq_along(names(results_multi_hivneg$model_data$extra_parms)),
  function(i) {
    predict_jm_trajectory(
      jm = results_multi_hivneg,
      metabolite_idx = i,
      data.long = jm_abu_inputdata_27$long_LTA4Hrm,
      time_vec = c(0, 30),
      name_map = name_map1
    )
  })

all_pop_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all_res, `[[`, "pop_df"))
all_obs_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all_res, `[[`, "obs_df"))
all_final_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all_res, `[[`, "final_df"))
sum(is.na(all_final_df$obs))

delta_labels <- beta_table_mv %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "Delta") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = sprintf(
      "\u2206\u03B2 = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]; Wald-p = %.3f",
      median,
      lwr,
      upr,
      fdr
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metabolite = dplyr::recode(
      metabolite,
      !!!name_map_delta
    )
  )

beta_table_display <- beta_table_mv
beta_table_display$metabolite <- name_map[beta_table_display$metabolite]
beta_table_display

plot_list <- lapply(
  met_order, function(met_name) {
    plot_met_trajectory(
      met_name = met_name,
      all_final_df = all_final_df,
      all_pop_df = all_pop_df,
      name_map = name_map3)
    })
combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 5)
combined_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "./plots/HIVneg_trajectory.tiff",
  plot = combined_plot,
  device = "tiff",
  width = 23,
  height = 14,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```
